steps.title: Analyze Compiler Diagnostic Logs
steps.description: Reviewed compileDebugJavaWithJavac error pointing to SplashActivity.java containing a stray trailing timestamp marker.

steps.title: Clean SplashActivity Source
steps.description: Removed trailing log marker characters from SplashActivity.java to correct compilation issues.

steps.title: Analyze Build Script Dependencies
steps.description: Checked app/build.gradle for non-compliant third-party dependencies.

steps.title: Remove External Dependencies
steps.description: Removed NanoHTTPD dependency from app/build.gradle to comply with restriction rules.

steps.title: Refactor Manifest Declaration
steps.description: Removed package attribute from AndroidManifest.xml to align with latest Gradle namespace directives.

steps.title: Verify Main Activity Java Compatibility
steps.description: Ensured that MainActivity.java uses pure Java 8 syntax with anonymous inner classes instead of lambdas.

steps.title: Verify Splash Activity Java Compatibility
steps.description: Ensured SplashActivity.java uses pure Java 8 syntax with traditional anonymous inner classes.

steps.title: Validate Main Layout Grid
steps.description: Ensured activity_main.xml displays clean grids and elements using built-in SDK components.

steps.title: Validate Splash Layout Grid
steps.description: Inspected progress indicator properties in activity_splash.xml.

steps.title: Sanity Check Metadata Properties
steps.description: Ensured metadata properties are mapped correctly in app-meta.json.

steps.title: Building Modern Calculator
steps.description: Executing build chain suite to compile, link and package the application artifacts.

steps.title: Analyze Current UI Design
steps.description: Reviewed existing layout files, specifically `activity_main.xml`, to identify areas for aesthetic improvement.

steps.title: Define New Color Palette
steps.description: Selected a modern dark color scheme using built-in Android colors for a cohesive and beautiful look.

steps.title: Redesign Display Area
steps.description: Updated the background and text color of the `display_text_view` in `activity_main.xml` for better contrast and a sleek appearance.

steps.title: Apply Consistent Number Button Styling
steps.description: Modified the background and text color of all number buttons in `activity_main.xml` to a uniform dark grey with white text.

steps.title: Apply Operator Button Styling
steps.description: Updated the background and text color of arithmetic operator buttons (`/`, `*`, `-`, `+`) to a distinct blue with black text.

steps.title: Restyle Clear Button
steps.description: Changed the 'C' (clear) button's background to a lighter red and text color to white for better visibility and a modern feel.

steps.title: Restyle Equals Button
steps.description: Enhanced the '=' (equals) button's appearance with a vibrant green background and black text to make it stand out.

steps.title: Refine Decimal Button Styling
steps.description: Updated the '.' (decimal) button's background and text color to match the number buttons for consistency.

steps.title: Adjust Button Text Sizes
steps.description: Ensured consistent and readable text sizes for all calculator buttons to improve overall UI aesthetics.

steps.title: Final UI Review and Layout Adjustments
steps.description: Performed a comprehensive visual check of the `activity_main.xml` layout to ensure all elements are well-aligned, spaced, and aesthetically pleasing.

steps.title: Building Modern Calculator
steps.description: Executing build chain suite to compile, link, and package the application artifacts with the new UI.
